profile.headline: Software Engineer at Nsight
profile.summary: I am an enthusiastic person. I love to explore new technologies as well as expand my abilities and knowledge. I am determined, hard working, enterprising and dedicated. I have experience with a large number of different programming languages and related technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Green Bay, Wisconsin, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Spring Boot · Kubernetes · docker · Java · Computer Science

positions.title: Peer Mentor - Computer Science
positions.description: * Worked with students in the course CS 537 - Introduction to Operating Systems to solve problems and answer questions

positions.title: Code Sensei
positions.description:
* Worked with clients, aged 5 to 18, to teach programming skills through a proprietary, self-driven curriculum.
* Lead Summer camps to teach programming through various technologies

positions.title: Application Analyst
positions.description:
* Worked with internal clients to meet business needs by developing custom software.
* Developed training materials and led training sessions to make software accessible to staff.
* Maintained and supported existing software.

positions.title: Hardware and Software Support Consultant
positions.description:
* Developed customized software in the Java programming language to be used to access financial market data and process it for use by financial planning staff
* Enhanced report processing procedure, automating calculation of data based on hundreds of reports eliminating human error and significantly cutting down on staff time
* Installed newly purchased hardware for use in the office
* Repaired dysfunctional and broken hardware in order to improve efficiency and reduce costs

positions.title: After School Program Activity Assistant, Camp Hope Counselor
positions.description:
*Work with students from kindergarten through sixth grade
*Lead physical and educational activities
*Tutor students who are struggling with homework

positions.title: Math and Software Development Tutor
positions.description:
* Tutor students in math and assist with homework completion from elementary algebra to calculus
* Approached by multiple students to provide individualized assistance in software development courses

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
* Created Objective-C and C++ game engine code as part of a software development team
* Implemented all required iPad features as well as general specified features in the game Atmo for iOS
* Accomplished successful testing in a group environment

positions.title: Research Assistant in Data Analysis
positions.description:
* Developed computer programs in the Perl programming language to retrieve specific data from web-based test framework
*Designed Perl scripts to parse the specified usage information from the retrieved data
*Generated Perl source code to export formatted information in the form of Microsoft Excel Spreadsheets
